# runzero_scan (Resource)

Triggers a RunZero scan on a site. Scans cannot be updated; changing any attribute forces a new scan.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the scan.
- `site_id` (String) The site ID to scan.
- `targets` (String) Scan targets as a string (IP addresses, CIDR ranges, hostnames, separated by spaces or commas).

### Optional

- `agent` (String) The UUID of the agent to run the scan.
- `description` (String) Description of the scan.
- `excludes` (String) Targets to exclude from the scan.
- `explorer` (String) The UUID of the explorer to run the scan.
- `explorer_group_id` (String) The UUID of the explorer group to run the scan.
- `host_ping` (String) Whether to perform host ping (true/false).
- `host_ping_probes` (String) Probes to use for host ping.
- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The UUID of the hosted zone to run the scan.
- `hosted_zone_name` (String) The name of the hosted zone to run the scan.
- `max_attempts` (String) Maximum probe attempts per host.
- `max_group_size` (String) Maximum target group size.
- `max_host_rate` (String) Maximum rate per host.
- `max_sockets` (String) Maximum concurrent sockets.
- `max_ttl` (String) Maximum TTL (hop limit) for probes.
- `nameservers` (String) Comma-separated list of nameservers to use.
- `passes` (String) Number of scan passes.
- `probes` (String) Comma-separated list of probes to use.
- `rate` (String) Scan rate (packets per second).
- `scan_frequency` (String) Scan frequency: once, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, continuous.
- `scan_grace_period` (String) Grace period before a recurring scan is considered late.
- `scan_start` (String) Scheduled start time for the scan (RFC3339 or relative).
- `scan_tags` (String) Tags to apply to discovered assets.
- `scan_template` (String) The UUID of the scan template to use.
- `screenshots` (String) Whether to capture screenshots (true/false).
- `subnet_ping` (String) Whether to perform subnet ping (true/false).
- `subnet_ping_net_size` (String) Subnet size for subnet ping sampling.
- `subnet_ping_probes` (String) Probes to use for subnet ping.
- `subnet_ping_sample_rate` (String) Sample rate for subnet ping.
- `tcp_excludes` (String) TCP ports to exclude from the scan.
- `tcp_ports` (String) TCP ports to scan (e.g. 1-1000,5000-6000).
- `tos` (String) IP type-of-service (ToS) byte for probes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the scan task.
- `status` (String) The status of the scan.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the scan was last updated.
